findings.text: follow-on: the added effective_ceiling comparison (limit = budget.effective_ceiling(judged, 'dispatch'); utilisation >= limit) duplicates the ceiling branch budget.decide already performs at reckon/budget.py:1455-1472 and contradicts the plan's fixed design that the budget exclusion "makes no raw ceiling comparison of its own"; because a fresh reading already requires headroom 'known' and unexpired, decide returns held before this block in every reachable state, so the block is unreachable dead logic whose docstring at :1148-1151 claims a refusal it cannot produce.

follow-on: _effective_budget_block restates the effective-block resolution routing._config_with_effective_budget already owns at reckon/crew/routing.py:406-428, and _budget_exclusion_reasons restates the wallet-block-plus-budget.decide composition routing._budget_verdict owns at reckon/crew/routing.py:434-491; the picker could share that composition instead of keeping a second copy that can drift from the dispatch path it is meant to mirror.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from 3d3e2b547 to 7e382df33; 0dcb440da replaces the picker's raw ceiling comparison with three helpers and a credit_lift term, and 7e382df33 adds only the evidence fragment, so the landed surface is one production file, one new test file and one fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the node's done_when names five cases, a six-file -rA gate with a base arm, two negative controls and a ruff pair; the manifest records each and the logs back it (gate-head.log 1 failed/36 passed EXIT=1, gate-base.log 4 failed/33 passed EXIT=1, negative-control-raw-ceiling.log EXIT=1, negative-control-window-term.log EXIT=1, ruff.log no added finding), and tests/test_a_credit_lifted_lane_is_open_but_scarce.py asserts the five named cases.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that the picker exclude a lane exactly when a dispatch of the pick's purpose would be held, reading the lift-aware budget verdict, and judge a reserved lane under a credits lift by its credit pool; reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:1120 _budget_exclusion_reasons now reads budget.decide through the group's effective block, and :1214 gives _reserved_lane_exclusion a credit_lift term that yields to the credit pool.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it names commits 0dcb440da and 7e382df33, the 1-failed/36-passed head gate against 4-failed/33-passed base, both negative controls with red EXIT=1, the ruff pair, and a follow-on naming tests/test_picker_pressure.py whose stale reserve-hold test the coordinator must bring along.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the brief grants reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py, tests/test_a_credit_lifted_lane_is_open_but_scarce.py, the node's evidence fragment and docs/figures/lane-and-model-routing/a-credit-lifted-lane-is-open-but-scarce; git diff --stat 3d3e2b547..7e382df33 changes exactly the first three, all inside the grant, and the figures directory is unused.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_credit_lifted_lane_is_open_but_scarce.py reads the candidate output rather than the value it passed in, and the two negative-control logs show each declared mutation reddens it, so the assertions do not move with the input they were handed.
justifications.evidence: the manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite name gate-base.log and gate-head.log with their failure ids, and gate-head.log carries the 1-failed/36-passed summary and its EXIT=1 line.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:1120-1171 follows the module's deferred-import and reason-string idiom and introduces no plan, ticket or version identifier in a name or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:1132-1140 reads the verdict of budget.decide through budget_group.effective_block for purpose dispatch, and :1214 makes a reserved lane under a credits lift yield its window term to the credit pool the verdict already judges.
justifications.reuse: the new gate calls the existing owners budget.decide (reckon/budget.py:1344) and budget_group.effective_block (reckon/crew/budget_group.py:158) rather than reimplementing budget logic, but its block resolution and policy/decide composition partly restate routing._config_with_effective_budget and routing._budget_verdict.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 3d3e2b547..7e382df33 changes only reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py, tests/test_a_credit_lifted_lane_is_open_but_scarce.py and the node fragment, all inside the declared grant.
